ApprovalAction.title: ApprovalAction
ApprovalAction.description: Move one revision's approval. content_sha256 names the exact text: another revision's, or a stale view's, is a 409.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The publication the approval must authorize. Simulation readings never authorize production.

approval.title: Approval
approval.description: An approval record from the core's PolicyCompiler.approve. Without one, the compiler makes it here.

Backend.title: Backend
Backend.description: A registered backend, which is an execution adapter (the protocol a model needs), or the LangGraph orchestrator.

Baseline.title: Baseline
Baseline.description: This compilation beside the latest published version: what its rules change, and the earlier decisions.

BatchResult.title: BatchResult
BatchResult.description: A batch's results, in receipt ID order.

name.title: Name
name.description: Required unless the file names the dataset

context_complete.title: Context Complete
context_complete.description: Whether the receipts are all that could matter to a rule spanning receipts; true by default

max_spend_usd.title: Max Spend Usd
max_spend_usd.description: US dollars, as text or an exact number, such as "0.50"

max_receipts.title: Max Receipts
max_receipts.description: Refuses the run unless the dataset holds at most this many receipts

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description:
Independent limits of a live run: each one given applies, and one left out is no limit of that kind.
Best effort: a call's cost is known only once it returns (see EVALUATIONS.md).

ChangeRequestCreate.title: ChangeRequestCreate
ChangeRequestCreate.description:
A reviewer's request that one compared field be corrected before the extraction is used. It changes nothing
itself: no document, reading or version is rewritten. While open, no version is made from the extraction, and no
version made from it is approved.

ClassificationModel.title: ClassificationModel
ClassificationModel.description: A model the deployment names for classification, with the one execution adapter its ID needs.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: openrouter, jev or langgraph, as the deployment allows

langgraph.title: Langgraph
langgraph.description: Changes to config.yaml's classification.langgraph, as the core's langgraph_config takes them

replay_set.title: Replay Set
replay_set.description: A named set of recorded answers, replay mode only

ClassificationSelection.title: ClassificationSelection
ClassificationSelection.description: The classification this request chooses. Anything left out comes from the core's config.yaml.

recording_set.title: Recording Set
recording_set.description: A server-side set of recorded readings; the compiler never calls a model here

CompileSource.title: CompileSource
CompileSource.description: Policy documents for the core's PolicyCompiler, read from one named set of recorded readings.

content.title: Content
content.description: UTF-8 Markdown in the policy-document format, stored exactly as sent

DocumentScope.title: DocumentScope
DocumentScope.description: Where a document applies, as given: regions, entities and expense types. Empty is not stated.

DocumentSource.title: DocumentSource
DocumentSource.description: Where the text came from. Recorded as given: provenance, not proof.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Evaluate against a version not published for production, where the deployment allows previews

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: replay (the default) reads only recorded answers; live calls paid providers

confirm_live.title: Confirm Live
confirm_live.description: Live only: true to confirm that this run calls paid providers

budget.description: Live only: at least one limit, unless confirm_uncapped

confirm_uncapped.title: Confirm Uncapped
confirm_uncapped.description: Live only: true, with no budget, to confirm a run with no spending, call or receipt limit

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: The same key and request return the same evaluation

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Explicit immutable revisions. With run_mode, IDs or filenames may instead resolve latest revisions

run_mode.title: Run Mode
run_mode.description: full: selected or all latest documents; incremental: merge changed documents into a published base; remove: exclude documents and derived rules from a published base. None preserves the original exact-revision API

ruleset_name.title: Ruleset Name
ruleset_name.description: Resolve the latest published version of this name; without it incremental/removal uses the latest published version company-wide

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: replay reads recorded readings; live calls a paid model and must be allowed by the deployment

recording_set.title: Recording Set
recording_set.description: Replay only: the recorded readings to read

recorded_with.description: Replay only: read only readings recorded live with these settings

extraction_model.title: Extraction Model
extraction_model.description: Live only: the model, from the deployment's allowed models

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Live only. The core checks it

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Live only. The core checks it

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who asks for the rule overrides: needed with them

rule_overrides.title: Rule Overrides
rule_overrides.description: Reviewed corrections of the draft rules, such as a param a revised policy changes. The compiler builds and validates them like the rule logic itself; each needs a rationale

carry_overrides_from.title: Carry Overrides From
carry_overrides_from.description: A published ruleset version whose rule corrections this compilation keeps, each with its own reviewer and rationale. A rule given in rule_overrides replaces that rule's carried correction

ExtractionJob.title: ExtractionJob
ExtractionJob.description: An extraction running in the background: where it is, and, once finished, its extraction or why it failed.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: reading: the documents, one at a time (live); building: the candidate ruleset

ExtractionSource.title: ExtractionSource
ExtractionSource.description: A stored extraction of document revisions, with the review that readies it unless it needed none.

FieldComparison.title: FieldComparison
FieldComparison.description:
Compare one typed rule field across extractors.

Attributes:
    comparison_id: Identity bound to document text, rule, and field.
    regex_value: Regex reading; rule presence is present or absent.
    agreed_value: Shared value when readings agree.
    evidence: Supporting clause text, if available.
    location: Section and heading line, if available.
    review_required: Whether exceptions_only review requires a decision.

Orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
Orchestrator.description: How lines reach a model: direct (the chosen model's adapter classifies every line) or LangGraph (its configured nodes).

PolicyDocumentInput.title: PolicyDocumentInput
PolicyDocumentInput.description:
One policy document in the existing Markdown format.

Attributes:
    document_id: The caller's identifier, carried into results.
    filename: A bare .md name, with no folder. Rules and approvals refer to documents by it.
    content: The document text.

PreparedReview.title: PreparedReview
PreparedReview.description: The extraction review a version was made from: the lifecycle review reuses its decisions unless given others.

PreviousDecision.title: PreviousDecision
PreviousDecision.description:
A field of this compilation beside the same field in the published version, with the decision it was published with.

unchanged: same clause text and the same readings, so the earlier decision answers the same question.
changed: the clause or a reading changed since, so the earlier decision must be made again.

duplicate_of.title: Duplicate Of
duplicate_of.description: Marks this document a duplicate of another with identical content, hidden in the library; null restores it. Nothing is deleted.

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description:
A document's business description, kept apart from its revisions: changing it never touches a revision's text.

Only the fields given are changed; a category of null makes the document unclassified.

approval_reference.title: Approval Reference
approval_reference.description: The approval to publish. Another one is a 409.

Readiness.title: Readiness
Readiness.description:
Where a version stands on Edit, Resolve, Approve, Publish, as the API judges it now. Publishing still
rebuilds the version and checks its approval: can_publish says only that nothing stands in the way.

RecordedWith.title: RecordedWith
RecordedWith.description: The generation settings readings were recorded live with, to replay exactly those readings.

extraction_sha256.title: Extraction Sha256
extraction_sha256.description: The snapshot this review is of: another is a 409

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: The core's ReviewDecision records: confirm, accept_regex, accept_llm, override or reject

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: The core's ReviewDecision records, one per comparison, for this version's extraction

ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest
ReviewRequest.description: A review decision. Accepting a compiled version needs the compiler's review decisions unless nothing awaits one.

RevisionApprovalState.title: RevisionApprovalState
RevisionApprovalState.description: The approval of one exact revision. Every revision starts as a draft: none inherits another's approval.

based_on_revision.title: Based On Revision
based_on_revision.description: The revision this one replaces. Any other revision created since is a 409.

RevisionCreate.title: RevisionCreate
RevisionCreate.description: New content for an existing document, which keeps its filename: rules cite documents by filename.

add.title: Add
add.description: A new rule for a clause the documents state and no rule implements: set also gives its scope, source_quote and params

RuleChange.title: RuleChange
RuleChange.description:
New values for some of one rule's logic: status, title, outcome, severity, applies_when, select, waived_by_ref or params.
The compiler validates them; anything else is refused.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why these rules change: kept in the new version's audit

RuleEdits.title: RuleEdits
RuleEdits.description: How a version made by editing another differs from it: field by field, with who and why.

artifact.title: Artifact
artifact.description: A compiled ruleset in the core's RuleSet schema. Structurally checked only: it can never be approved.

compile.description: Policy documents to compile here, from one recording set.

extraction.description: A reviewed extraction of stored document revisions (POST /v1/documents/extractions).

based_on_version.title: Based On Version
based_on_version.description: The version this one replaces. When given, any other version created since is a 409.

RulesetCreate.title: RulesetCreate
RulesetCreate.description: A new draft version from exactly one source: an extraction, policy documents to compile, or an uploaded artifact.

RulesetPermissions.title: RulesetPermissions
RulesetPermissions.description: Which ruleset versions requests may use here.

RulesetSource.title: RulesetSource
RulesetSource.description: Where the content came from. Recorded as given: it is provenance, not proof.

SourceLocation.title: SourceLocation
SourceLocation.description: Where a compared field's source is, verified against the exact revision the compiler read; never approximate.

Taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
Taxonomy.description: Read from the core's rules/fields.yaml and data/category-taxonomy.md. A section the catalog lacks is None.

Translation.title: Translation
Translation.description: The translator: called only for non-English lines, but counted among a live run's models whenever enabled.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.description: Raw receipt records in the core's format (data/README.md), without labels or notes

context_complete.title: Context Complete
context_complete.description: Whether every receipt that could matter to a cross-receipt rule is included, true by default: submit all relevant receipts in one batch. False leaves totals a missing receipt could change undecided.

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: replay (the default) answers only from recordings; live calls paid providers and must be allowed by the deployment

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Validate against a version that is not published for production, such as a draft. Only where the deployment allows previews; the run records it.

VersionChanges.title: VersionChanges
VersionChanges.description:
A version beside the version published before it: each rule field that differs (a rule only one has is field
"rule"). against is None when no other version was published before it.
